title: Stop selling (typed confirmation)
summary: The Stop selling confirmation for Dice skins: what happens on each store (App Store removed from sale now, Google Play deactivated now, Steam stays on sale because it has no API, with the place to change it), that owners keep it, and the typed app name before 'Stop selling on 2 stores', shown mid-typing with the button still disabled.
compare: Opened from the offer editor's one page action, Stop selling…; the editor stays behind the scrim.

ADMIN.md L3: changing an In-App Purchase's availability types the app's name as App Store Connect shows it (Diceroll), drawn as a neutral confirm word because nothing is lost. Intent caution: a warning icon before the title.

One line per store with its mark: what happens there and when. A store with no API is listed muted as 'stays on sale' with the one thing to do (turn off DLC 2817450 in Steamworks) and a deep link; it is never counted in the button.
The first line says what doesn't change: owners keep Dice skins, restores still work, and it can go back on sale later.

The confirm button names the outcome and the count of stores the API reaches ('Stop selling on 2 stores') and stays disabled (aria-disabled) until the typed word matches; the picture shows 'Dicer' typed.
On success the header status turns to 'Not on sale' (muted) and the page action becomes Start selling…; a store error stays inline in its row, as in commerce.offer-price-failed.
Phone: a bottom sheet with the body scrolling and the buttons pinned, primary on top.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink; focus, hover, checked and selected take the accent of the service the element references (B17), never a status colour; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.

Dialog and drawer head (B4): a 3px rule in the origin's accent along the top (none on a destructive or cautious confirmation), a head band with a hairline, one leading glyph or none (severity on a confirmation, the subject's mark on a record, never a service tile), title at or under 20/28; blurred backdrop with a flat fallback under reduced transparency.
On a phone the typed confirmation sits with the pinned buttons (admin-3-07).

m9 (round 2): the caution intent (ADMIN.md L3, nothing is lost) is drawn consistently: the warning glyph and the ink primary, never a red button; the typed word stays the app's name as App Store Connect shows it (Diceroll), per L3.

findings.issue: A green primary signals a positive action for a store-side withdrawal.
findings.resolution: 'Stop selling on 2 stores' uses the danger button (locked while the word is not typed); typed confirm kept.
